packages.integration: Vendored package; authoritative editable SceneSnapshot and Plugin API v2.
packages.rationale: Required by the integrated editor and revision bridge.

packages.integration: Vendored viewer embedded in the local floorplanner host.
packages.rationale: Retains native rendering and selection semantics.

packages.integration: Vendored editor component mounted once by @arcz/aedifex-floorplanner.
packages.rationale: Preserves the complete upstream authoring experience without duplicating editor state.

packages.integration: builtinPlugin is loaded through Plugin API v2.
packages.rationale: All admitted built-in node kinds remain native.

packages.integration: In-memory MCP server over a revision-isolated SceneBridge; mutations require revision match and approval.
packages.rationale: Reuses upstream tools without network dependency or direct scene writes.

packages.integration: treesPlugin and treesHostPanel loaded locally through Plugin API v2.
packages.rationale: Preserves the upstream community tree extension.

packages.integration: IFC bytes convert locally to the native Aedifex scene graph with transactional persistence/rollback.
packages.rationale: No external IFC service or format simulation.

packages.integration: Preserved only in the vendored workspace build; not an ARCZ runtime domain.
packages.rationale: Monorepo configuration packages are required for reproducible compilation.

packages.integration: Classify package ownership and runtime exposure before updating the pin.
packages.rationale: Unknown packages can introduce duplicate state, network calls or incompatible licenses.

apps.integration: The pure converter package is used inside one ARCZ Import/Export panel; the standalone demo app is not shipped.
apps.rationale: Avoids duplicate IFC UIs while retaining converter capability.

apps.integration: Upstream demo/editor app is preserved as reference; @arcz/aedifex-floorplanner is the only shipped host.
apps.rationale: One shell, one scene store, no competing project persistence.

apps.integration: Decide whether to fold, preserve as reference, or reject each additional upstream app.
apps.rationale: Apps may contain providers, databases or duplicate UX.

plugins.integration: Loaded with duplicate guard through loadPlugin().
plugins.rationale: Pinned and included in the UI.

plugins.integration: Owned by the admitted tree plugin.
plugins.rationale: Source-level declarations are covered by the package admission.

plugins.integration: Run compatibility, license, cleanup, deterministic serialization and offline tests.
plugins.rationale: Community plugins never auto-install merely because they are found.

node_kinds.integration: Update the lock, UI/tool admission tests and this policy before accepting a new node kind.
node_kinds.rationale: A new upstream kind must not silently enter the authoring surface.

mcp_tools.integration: Discovered from the real in-memory MCP catalog; read/export tools are isolated and every other tool defaults to approval-required mutation with expected_revision.
mcp_tools.rationale: New tools fail safe as mutations and cannot commit without an approval id and optimistic concurrency check.

api_routes.integration: Only routes in the ARCZ overlay app are built; upstream application routes remain in the immutable reference tree.
api_routes.rationale: Prevents remote/provider routes from becoming implicit dependencies.

environment_variables.integration: Only variables explicitly declared by the overlay runtime manifest may be injected.
environment_variables.rationale: Unknown NEXT variables remain visible in the inventory.

environment_variables.integration: Upstream provider settings are not propagated; the overlay route calls ARCZ Local AI Broker.
environment_variables.rationale: Core inference remains local and provider-optional.

environment_variables.integration: Provider credentials are not injected; Google map/AI data is never a core dependency.
Validated loopback URL/token/model/runtime fields owned by ARCZ.
Classify whether the variable is build-only, local runtime, credential, telemetry or remote provider.
environment_variables.rationale: Environment variables are an egress and secret-injection surface.

external_urls.integration: Recorded for provenance/documentation; runtime egress remains denied.
external_urls.rationale: Repository links are not fetched during offline operation.
Offline build uses local cache/vendor material.

external_urls.integration: Allowed only during explicit import_assisted dependency materialization; never runtime core.
external_urls.rationale: Build artifacts must be materialized before offline use.

external_urls.integration: XML/SVG namespace string, not a network request.
Schema/namespace reference, not implicit runtime egress.
Determine whether the URL is inert documentation, localizable asset, optional import connector or forbidden runtime endpoint.
external_urls.rationale: Unreviewed remote strings can become hidden provider dependencies.

network_call_sites.rationale: Network behavior exists only in tests.

network_call_sites.integration: Original app is not the built runtime; overlay routes are audited separately.
network_call_sites.rationale: No hidden app-level provider calls are inherited.

network_call_sites.integration: Native AI UI is retained, but its route is replaced by the ARCZ loopback Local AI Broker endpoint.
network_call_sites.rationale: Preserves the complete chat UX without remote-provider authority.

network_call_sites.integration: Inspect request target, capability, cancellation, timeout and offline fallback before accepting the upstream commit.
network_call_sites.rationale: Runtime package network calls are not admitted by default.
